epics.name: Workspace and engineering foundation
epics.outcome: build and change the product reproducibly
epics.deliverable: A versioned monorepo with locked toolchains, generated contracts and enforced module boundaries
epics.acceptance: A clean supported machine can bootstrap and run the owned-code checks without relying on LocalMind dependencies.

epics.name: Native host and sidecar lifecycle
epics.outcome: run a stable desktop application with controlled native access
epics.deliverable: A launchable Tauri host with a supervised Python runtime, scoped IPC and vaulted credentials
epics.acceptance: The actual native app starts, remains responsive, handles sidecar failure and exits without orphaning owned processes.

epics.name: Task-first user experience
epics.outcome: delegate work and understand progress, exceptions and results
epics.deliverable: A task composer, activity view, approval review, results and settings with rendered accessibility evidence
epics.acceptance: A user completes the core flow through the rendered desktop UI using mouse and keyboard at supported sizes.

epics.name: Task contracts and persistence
epics.outcome: preserve task state and evidence across failures
epics.deliverable: Typed contracts, transactional task storage, resumable events and verified artifact storage
epics.acceptance: Restart, concurrency, backup and interrupted-write tests preserve consistent task and artifact state.

epics.name: Model providers and inference controls
epics.outcome: use real inference with observable capabilities and resource limits
epics.deliverable: Local and hosted provider adapters with streaming, cancellation, usage accounting and governed fallback
epics.acceptance: Real model calls pass the provider contract and restricted data never reaches an unapproved fallback provider.

epics.name: Agent loop and tool execution
epics.outcome: complete bounded multi-step tasks through typed tools
epics.deliverable: A durable bounded agent loop, validated tool registry, safe execution and idempotent operation ledger
epics.acceptance: A real tool-using run succeeds and malformed actions, retries and uncertain writes preserve the declared invariants.

epics.name: Permissions, approvals and audit
epics.outcome: authorize exact actions and trace their effects
epics.deliverable: Execution-time policies, immutable approval scopes, revocation and verifiable audit exports
epics.acceptance: Changed proposals, revoked grants, injected instructions and duplicate decisions produce no unauthorized effects.

epics.name: Document intake and evidence
epics.outcome: supply business documents with inspectable field provenance
epics.deliverable: Validated PDF, OCR, tabular and email intake with versions, corrections and stable citations
epics.acceptance: Supported documents retain source locations and malformed or low-confidence data cannot silently become trusted facts.

epics.name: Invoice exception employee
epics.outcome: resolve invoice exceptions with evidence and approved draft actions
epics.deliverable: A complete invoice-to-resolution workflow and a stateful fixture ERP
epics.acceptance: A real model processes fixtures through matching, review, one idempotent draft write and a verified reconciliation result.

epics.name: Durable remote workflows
epics.outcome: resume long-running work after outages and human review
epics.deliverable: Temporal workers, review signals, reconciliation, compensation and replay-compatible versions
epics.acceptance: Worker loss, delayed approval and duplicate delivery do not duplicate effects or lose unresolved outcomes.

epics.name: Enterprise connector framework
epics.outcome: connect permitted test systems through consistent contracts
epics.deliverable: Connector manifests, MCP, OAuth, sandbox drive/ticket adapters and sanitized recordings
epics.acceptance: At least one configured sandbox integration passes live contract tests, throttling and revocation checks.

epics.name: Retrieval and context construction
epics.outcome: retrieve relevant permitted evidence and identify retrieval failures
epics.deliverable: Versioned chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking and context assembly
epics.acceptance: Held-out retrieval results include recall and citation coverage, and stale or cross-tenant evidence is excluded.

epics.name: Reviewed memory and context graph
epics.outcome: reuse relevant experience without leaking or accumulating false lessons
epics.deliverable: Scoped reviewed memories, conflict resolution, expiry, provenance graph and transfer tests
epics.acceptance: Memory-on/off tests distinguish transfer from memorization and revocation removes influence on subsequent runs.

epics.name: Reproducible task environments
epics.outcome: repeat realistic tasks and test rewards before optimization
epics.deliverable: Snapshot environments, simulated users, fault injection, verifiable rewards and isolated resets
epics.acceptance: A fixed seed reproduces initial state and reward exploits fail before environment use in training.

epics.name: Evaluation and statistical evidence
epics.outcome: separate real improvements from leakage, judge bias and run variance
epics.deliverable: Repeated-run evaluation, calibrated judges, paired statistics and gated comparison reports
epics.acceptance: Candidate reports include complete denominators, independent-unit uncertainty, quality, latency, cost and leakage checks.

epics.name: Trace-to-dataset engine
epics.outcome: turn permitted reviewed traces into reproducible training data
epics.deliverable: Redacted trajectories, preference pairs, quality diagnostics, lineage and TRL exports
epics.acceptance: Every exported row has permitted source lineage and withdrawn or rejected data is excluded from new dataset versions.

epics.name: Post-training and model promotion
epics.outcome: test a defensible training intervention against the unchanged model
epics.deliverable: Hardware preflight, SFT/DPO entry points, checkpoint evaluation, serving and controlled promotion
epics.acceptance: One completed experiment reports held-out task and retention results; a clean negative result also satisfies research completion.

epics.name: Inference efficiency and intervention research
epics.outcome: improve complete-task quality within latency and cost budgets
epics.deliverable: Routing, selective verification, safe caching and reproducible intervention comparisons
epics.acceptance: A full-agent comparison against declared baselines includes failed attempts, cost uncertainty and transfer limitations.

epics.name: Observability and reliability
epics.outcome: diagnose degradation and verify recovery under load
epics.deliverable: Traces, metrics, redacted diagnostics, SLO rules, alerts and failure/load scenarios
epics.acceptance: Injected failures are visible in telemetry and recovery preserves correct business state within measured limits.

epics.name: Security and data governance
epics.outcome: protect credentials, tenant data and executable boundaries
epics.deliverable: Filesystem/egress enforcement, plugin verification, retention and adversarial security tests
epics.acceptance: Real boundary tests deny cross-scope access, secret leaks and unauthorized effects; scanner failures fail closed.

epics.name: Team services and infrastructure
epics.outcome: operate isolated workspaces and durable workers remotely
epics.deliverable: OIDC, PostgreSQL isolation, object storage, service containers and optional remote deployment infrastructure
epics.acceptance: Two test tenants remain isolated across API, storage and work execution, and containers start from locked inputs.

epics.name: GitHub delivery pipelines
epics.outcome: ship only artifacts with reviewable quality and provenance evidence
epics.deliverable: PR, integration, UI, native, supply-chain, GPU and staged promotion workflows
epics.acceptance: Actual GitHub runs demonstrate required-gate failure behavior and protect release credentials from untrusted code.

epics.name: Desktop distribution and upgrades
epics.outcome: install, update and recover the application safely
epics.deliverable: Installer, controlled signing, updater, migration recovery and release evidence verifier
epics.acceptance: An isolated Windows profile installs and upgrades the app with intact user data; unavailable signing remains explicitly unsigned.

epics.name: Additional workflows and contributor ecosystem
epics.outcome: extend the engine and demonstrate transfer beyond invoice tasks
epics.deliverable: Onboarding/access fixtures, optional multimodal IO, skill registry, SDK and contributor kit
epics.acceptance: Implemented extensions pass the shared contracts and cross-domain evaluation reports do not reuse training families.

releases.name: Native recovery checkpoint
releases.scope: Repair the existing startup failure and apply the working identity. This is not a functioning AI employee.
releases.acceptance: A packaged native window stays open and displays the Veya shell with startup diagnostics retained.

releases.name: First real delegated task
releases.scope: One read-only document task through the desktop, a real local model and typed tools.
releases.acceptance: User submits an instruction and document; the model uses permitted tools and returns a cited result. Failure and cancellation remain explicit.

releases.name: Invoice MVP
releases.scope: Invoice discrepancy resolution, approval and one verified fixture-ERP draft write. No real payments.
releases.acceptance: The native workflow completes the invoice acceptance suite with real inference, evidence, review, idempotency and verified final fixture state.

releases.name: Evaluation and learning beta
releases.scope: Repeatable environments, meaningful baseline comparison, one SFT experiment and intervention evaluation.
releases.acceptance: A reproducible report measures held-out task outcomes, uncertainty, violations, latency and cost. Negative results are valid research outcomes.

releases.name: Operational desktop release
releases.scope: Core and research roadmap with team services and distribution; optional stretch remains separately selectable.
releases.acceptance: Required core and research deliverables pass their gates, native install/upgrade is verified, and configured GitHub pipelines have real successful runs.

releases.name: Full optional research roadmap
releases.scope: All 240 stories, including experiments and additional workflows. This is not the first-release commitment.
releases.acceptance: All selected extensions have their own evidence and no unsupported claims of novelty or production scale.
